name: Skaabs
description: Shambling stitched-together corpses created by Geralf, used as bodyguards, couriers and an attack force.

timeline.summary: Grete's prison caravan carrying Gisa is attacked by misshapen skaabs and Gisa escapes in the chaos.
timeline.quote: we were overcome by a sudden attack of ghastly, violent, misshapen skaabs.

timeline.summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
timeline.quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

relations.note: He has made his name creating them.
relations.quote: the very creatures I have made my name creating

pages_say.description: Shambling stitched-together corpses created by Geralf, used as bodyguards, couriers and an attack force.
